crossRefs.note: “ ‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.
“Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways…
Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways…
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…
Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according…
and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the…
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’ ”
translations.bsb: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.”
translations.kjv: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
translations.asv: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
